# OmniComms AI

> The first unified voice-first AI solution for autonomous AI Employees.

OmniComms AI is the first unified voice-first AI solution for autonomous AI Employees. It provides unified business context for autonomous AI Employee execution — built for regulated professionals (loan officers, mortgage brokers, realtors, insurance agents, financial advisors) whose income depends on relationships and whose license depends on documentation. Tagline: "We help you scale You!"

## Capabilities

- Voice-first interface: give instructions by speaking naturally
- Omnichannel: phone, SMS, email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok, Telegram, YouTube, Reddit
- Persistent memory: every conversation, every channel, every client — for years
- Human-in-the-loop: mission-critical actions require real-time approval via push notification
- Full audit trail: every interaction logged immutably for compliance

## AG-UI Integration — The Communications Layer for AI Agents

OmniComms AI is integrating with AG-UI, the open agent-to-UI protocol (originated by CopilotKit, adopted by Microsoft Agent Framework, Google ADK, AWS Bedrock, LangGraph, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, and others). Our goal: become the universal communications layer for every AI Agent on the internet — so any AI Agent built on any framework can reach a real human across phone, SMS, WhatsApp, email, or social DM with a single click.

- No server setup. No hosting required. No telephony stack to assemble.
- Bring your own agent: developers keep their own agent code, models, prompts, and orchestration — and extend it by wiring OmniComms AI in as the communication bridge/highway that pushes those interactions out into the real world (calls, texts, social messaging, email).
- Any AG-UI-compliant agent can plug into OmniComms AI and instantly gain real-world communication channels.
- Conversely, third-party AG-UI clients (CopilotKit dashboards, Microsoft Agent Framework UIs, custom apps) can run an OmniComms AI Employee through their own interface as a hosted agent.
- Roadmap: outbound bridge (third-party agents dispatch via our provider stack), inbound routing (incoming channel messages forwarded to a registered third-party agent), A2A discovery (Google Agent-to-Agent), and an MCP server exposing platform capabilities as tools any LLM can call.
- Outcome: every AG-UI developer ecosystem becomes a distribution channel for AI Employees — and every AI Agent on the internet gains a turnkey path to real human interaction.

## Section: The Problem

- Headline: Every year, more professionals go independent.
- Body: Becoming "Solopreneurs." Some by choice. Some because the market decided for them.
- Body: Day one, the same two problems hit: How do I get leads? And when they come — how do I personally nurture hundreds of relationships by myself?
- Body: You can give 5 maybe 10 people your full attention. You cannot give 500.
- Accent: Not because you don't care. Because high-touch doesn't scale, until NOW.
- Accent: OmniComms AI is your leverage.

## Section: How It Works

- Headline: Stop managing software. Start delegating.
- Body: When you hire a human employee, you give them a phone line, standard operating procedures, restricted access to company systems, and a workspace device. Your AI Employee is no different.
- Accent: Give it the same things — and it can hear, see what you see, and execute tasks.
- 01 — Tell it what to do: Give instructions with your voice — while you're driving, walking into a showing, or between calls. No typing required. Just talk.
- 02 — It sees everything: Your pipeline, your calendar, your conversations across every channel. Full context — not a blank prompt window.
- 03 — It acts on its own: Follows up with leads. Responds to texts. Sends documents. Schedules meetings. Takes real action — not just suggestions.
- 04 — It remembers forever: Every conversation, every channel, every client — for years. Context is never lost. And every interaction has a full audit trail.

## Section: Founder

- Lavon Woods — Founder & CEO, OmniComms AI. Licensed Mortgage Broker. 25+-year software engineer.
- Quote: "In 2019, I left a 20-year software engineering career to help my father in his mortgage business after he lost his sight. I thought I'd apply my tech skills to make it more efficient. Instead, I discovered a regulated relationship-based industry. You get one client, work on serving them for a while, then you have to run back to your pipeline to figure out which next client is ready. I spent years living this chaos until I learned the business and realized I needed to scale my capacity through automation. This is difficult to do in a people-based business. This is not a problem that I researched, I didn't interview people about it — I'm living it."

## Section: Why This Is Different

- Headline: Built compliant-first. Not bolted on later.
- Comparison rows (Everyone else vs OmniComms AI):
  - Build the demo first. Figure out compliance later. Maybe. → Security architecture and audit infrastructure from line one of code. The demo came second.
  - Voice-only or chat-only. No memory across channels. → Calls, texts, emails — one AI that remembers every interaction across every channel. Do Not Call compliance built in.
  - Built by engineers who don't know your pain points nor how your industry works. → Built by a licensed broker who uses this on his own deals. His license is on the line.
  - Session context dies when the call ends. Next interaction starts from zero. → Context carries across calls, texts, and emails — for years. Your AI never forgets a client.
  - Fully autonomous. No guardrails. Hope for the best. → Human-in-the-loop. Mission-critical actions require your approval in real time.
  - Generic AI voice. Sounds like every other bot on the market. → Trained on your voice, your process, your personality. Every call, text, email redacted for sensitive information, used as context for your AI.
- Summary: Demos are cool. We're building real-world infrastructure good enough for regulated professionals.

## Section: Enterprise Security — Coming Soon

- Headline: Your Keys. Your Data. Zero Trust Architecture.
- Body: Our platform is being built on a Zero Trust Master Key Architecture. Think of it like crypto — you hold the keys, not us.
- Encrypted at Rest: All data encrypted using keys that only you control. Powered by OpenBao vault infrastructure.
- Your Keys Required: The server cannot decrypt or access your data without your master key. We literally cannot see your information.
- Full Audit Trail: Every interaction logged immutably. Complete chain of custody for compliance officers and regulators.
- Note: Zero Trust Master Key Architecture is planned for our Enterprise tier. All tiers include end-to-end encryption and immutable audit logging from day one.

## Section: Human In The Loop

- Headline: Your AI doesn't go rogue. You stay in control.
- Body: When your AI Employee hits a decision that matters — sending a contract, making a commitment, scheduling something irreversible — it doesn't just act.
- Accent: It asks you first. In real time via push notification and text.
- Flow: (1) AI identifies a mission-critical action → (2) You get a real-time prompt with full context → (3) Approve, deny, or modify — then it continues.
- Sub: Other AI tools are fully autonomous with no guardrails. For regulated professionals, that's not a feature — it's a liability.

## Section: Patent

- Status: Patent Pending — filed November 16, 2025.
- Title: System and Method for Autonomous Multi-Modal Conversational AI Agent Operation Enabling Multi-Day Workflows Without Persistent Connections.
- Abstract: A system and method for autonomous multi-modal conversational AI agent operation enabling agents to conduct multi-day customer workflows without persistent connections or human intervention. The system provides event-driven agent activation enabling workflows spanning arbitrary time periods; cross-platform conversational continuity enabling agent access to complete conversation history regardless of communication platform; AI-triggered modality escalation enabling autonomous transition from asynchronous to synchronous communication with context preservation; resource-efficient scalability through separation of conversational state and compute processes; and runtime capability composition enabling agent behavior modification without code deployment.
- Field of invention: The present invention relates to autonomous conversational artificial intelligence systems for conducting complete customer workflows across multiple communication modalities and platforms without human intervention.
